name: fMRIPrep - Volume Output - ICA-AROMA
summary: Preprocesses BOLD fMRI with fMRIPrep 21.0.1 (optionally with ICA-AROMA) and outputs the ICA-AROMA denoised volume, brain masks, confound regressors, the AROMA noise components, transforms and an HTML report.
description: Fork of the brainlife fMRIPrep volume App that runs fMRIPrep 21.0.1 with a FreeSurfer input, SyN-based distortion correction and BBR, then maps the outputs to brainlife datatypes. Unlike the standard App, the bold_img output is the ICA-AROMA non-aggressively denoised, smoothed BOLD (desc-smoothAROMAnonaggr) and the list of AROMA noise components is saved, so the aroma parameter must be enabled for the BOLD output to exist. Needs a T1w, a raw BOLD and the FreeSurfer output of the same T1w; takes several hours with 16 cores.

inputs.description: t1 anatomy to register the input fmri data. Please be sure to use the same t1 used to generate the freesurfer input.
inputs.requirements: Must be the same T1w used to generate the FreeSurfer input.

inputs.description: freesurfer output used to aid preprocessing
Optional T2-weighted image of the same subject, converted into the BIDS input given to fMRIPrep.
2phasemag fieldmap is not yet supported by fmriprep (https://github.com/poldracklab/sdcflows/issues/15) - should be supported by now

outputs.description: ICA-AROMA non-aggressively denoised and smoothed BOLD time series (desc-smoothAROMAnonaggr) in the selected output space.
There is no such datatype tag for mask as "bold". It will be removed in favor of "func"
fMRIPrep confounds time series (regressors.tsv and its JSON sidecar).
preprocessed t1 (same alignment as the original t1, but level adjusted - editme)
Brain mask of the preprocessed T1w in the original T1w space.
ANTs composite transforms (.h5) between T1w and the template space, both directions, plus the affine to the template.
FreeSurfer aparc+aseg segmentation resampled by fMRIPrep to the T1w space, with a label.json.

parameters.description: output space of the preprocessed func/task output (bold).
Output resolution of the volumetric BOLD: the original BOLD resolution or the template res-2 (2 mm isotropic) grid.
Skip the BIDS validation of input data. Try this option if your data is not BIDS compatible but you'd like to go ahead and process it through fmriprep anyway.
Use ICA based procedure to identify confounding time series related to head-motion [Prium2015].

citations.text: Esteban O. et al. fMRIPrep: a robust preprocessing pipeline for functional MRI. Nature Methods 16, 111-116 (2019).

failure_modes.message: app needs minimally a T1w and fmri. exiting
failure_modes.fix: Provide both a T1w and an fMRI input.

failure_modes.cause: The FreeSurfer license is not available on the compute resource.
failure_modes.fix: Set FREESURFER_LICENSE in the environment of the resource running the App.
